synthetic-whitespace.pgp is a PUBLIC TEST-ONLY private P256 entity, not a credential. Generated once with pinned go-crypto v1.4.1; 657 bytes, SHA256 fbc7918e856947a3ef5331f93669ade507692ac4ecff1b4b56a5d1f7cb4a9f35. Final signature octet is ASCII whitespace. Concatenating two copies produces two valid entities; trimming the final byte makes ReadKeyRing skip the second. Tests pin the digest, parse counts, real binary/armor single success and duplicate denial. Never use this synthetic key outside tests. No probabilistic CI generation.
